title: Where AP2 sits among the eight protocols
caption: Solid lines are documented links: UCP embeds AP2 as an extension, a2a-x402 nests x402 inside AP2 v0.1 mandates, and Verifiable Intent shares AP2's mandate types and now sits with it at FIDO. Dotted lines mark analogies or the absence of any documented link. The AP2 repository does not mention TAP, ACP, Shared Payment Tokens, the Machine Payments Protocol or ERC-8004.
alt: Flowchart. UCP embeds AP2 through the extension dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate. AP2 links to x402 through the a2a-x402 Embedded Flow, which targets AP2 v0.1. AP2 and Mastercard Verifiable Intent share vct values with different constraint prefixes. The FIDO Alliance governs AP2 specification work and also received Verifiable Intent. AP2 samples run over A2A. ERC-8226, a draft on-chain mandate standard, is an analogue that does not reference AP2 and names ERC-8004 as its identity layer. Visa TAP, OpenAI ACP and Stripe MPP have no documented link to AP2.
